# SGBF and DGBF

Matrix $A$ is stored in general-band storage mode in the two-dimensional array $AGB$ of size $LDA$ by $N$, where $LDA = 2ml+mu+l6 = 23$. The array $AGB$ is declared as $AGB(1:23,1:9)$.

**Note:** Matrix $A$ is the same matrix used in the examples in subroutines SGEE and DGEF (see \"Example 1\" on page 453) and SGEFCD and DGEFCD (see \"Example\" on page 466).

# Call Statement and Input:

```
AGB    LDA    N     ML    MU    IPT
     |       |       |     |       |       |     |
CALL SGBF( AGB , 23 , 9 , 2 , 3 , IPT )
```
